generated.prompt: Create one clear word-cue illustration for a young child's literacy game: a single large U-shaped horseshoe magnet with two visibly separated short pole ends, red painted metal body and blue-painted pole tips. Two small steel paper clips are visibly attracted to one pole, showing why this object is a magnet. Keep the U-shaped opening empty and obvious, with the magnet centred and fully uncropped. Warm, simple children's storybook illustration, clean dark outlines, softly shaded solid colours, bright white square background, generous clean margin, readable at 64 pixels. No face, no characters, no scenery, no extra magnets. No written text whatsoever: no letters, words, labels, numerals, N or S symbols, signage, or watermarks.

Child's face and body readable, no distress, no disease. Warm hand-painted storybook illustration with rounded forms, soft watercolor/pencil texture and crisp friendly silhouette, neutral warm cream background, sparse scene, no inset panels. This will be shown at 56px and accompanied by the recorded word, so isolate the shivering gesture. Absolutely no text, letters, words, numerals, labels, signs, speech bubbles, watermarks or logos anywhere. Do not write the target word. Full body remains inside safe margins. Opaque cream background.
